Decided by Jack Heart, 2026-11-14: "for external services that are basically out of providers, you do your own budgeting on the API keys for now". So Etude does not account for or limit spend on outside APIs: its dollar limits count machine rental only, and the docs say so. The author budgets on the key (a spend-capped key, or stop thresholds in their own code as the Haiku runner had). Reporting API spend into Etude's limits or records is out of scope for now.
